GraceUXGuidelines.Audience: Engineers and agents driving the grace CLI and reading the shipped skill documentation.
GraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: Every CLI subcommand offers human-readable text output and machine-readable JSON via --format json or --json.
Status and lint output stays compact and scannable; integrity problems point at a concrete next action.
Exit codes are stable and documented so harnesses and agents can branch on them (for example grace afk budget/session codes).
Skill documentation follows the three-section discipline (Common Rationalizations, When NOT to Use, Verification) so agent-facing guidance stays predictable.
